videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
There’s a lot going on under the sea, and we’re not talking about singing crabs! From hydrothermal vents to trenches so deep you could fit Mount Everest inside them with room to spare. Come with us as we explore marine geology, the science of “what the heck is going on with the ocean floor?"

videos.title: How Water Shapes the Land: Crash Course Geology #9
videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
Drop by drop, water has the power to break rock and create whole new landforms. But how? In this episode of Crash Course Geology, we’ll trace how the water cycle works and how this humble geological force sculpts the land as we know it—faster than you might think.
